desc.en: The Ziyarat of Imam Mahdi (a) of the holy vault should be performed after the Ziyarat of Imam Hasan Askari (a) and his noble father Imam Hadi (a). Move towards the holy vault, then stand near its door and say…
desc.rurdu: Jab kabhi Hazrat Baqiyyatullah Al-Aazam ki Sardaab mein ziyarat karna chahe to pehle Hazrat Imam Haadi (a) aur Imam Hasan Askari (a) ki ziyarat kare aur jab un dono buzurgo’n ki ziyarat se faarigh ow jaaye to Sardaab-e-Muqaddas ki taraf jaaye aur uske darwaaze oar khade ho aur dua Izne Dukhul padhe…
desc.urdu: جب کبھی حضرت بقیۃ اللہ ارواحنا فداہ کی سرداب مقدس میں زیارت کرنا چاہیں تو پہلے حضرت امام ہادیؑ اور حضرت امام حسن عسکریؑ کی زیارت کریں اور جب ان دونوں بزرگوں کی زیارت سے فارغ ہو جائیں تو سردابِ مقدس کی طرف جائیں اور اس کے دروازے پر کھڑے ہوں اور دُعاء اذن دخول پڑھیں۔۔۔

arabic.text: بِسْمِ اللہِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِیْمِ

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اِلٰهِیْ اِنِّیْ قَدْ وَقَفْتُ عَلٰی بَابِ بَیْتٍ مِنْ بُیُوْتِ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهٖ، وَقَدْ مَنَعْتَ النَّاسَ مِنَ الدُّخُوْلِ اِلٰی بُیُوْتِهٖ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِهٖ، فَقُلْتَ۔ يَااَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ آمَنُوْا لَا تَدْخُلُوْا بُيُوْتَ النَّبِيِّ اِلَّا اَنْ يُّؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ۔

trans.en: O Lord! Indeed I stand at the door of a house amongst the houses of Your Prophet Mohammad, peace be upon him and his holy Progeny, and verily You have forbidden people from entering his houses without his permission, and have said: (O you who have believed, do not enter the houses of the Prophet except when you are permitted).
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعْتَقِدُ حُرْمَةَ نَبِیِّكَ فِيْ غَيْبَتِهٖ، كَمَا اَعْتَقِدُهَا فِيْ حَضْرَتِهٖ، وَاَعْلَمُ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَكَ وَخُلَفَآءَكَ اَحْيَآءٌ عِنْدَكَ يُرْزَقُوْنَ، يَرَوْنَ مَقَامِيْ، وَيَسْمَعُوَنْ كَلَامِيْ، وَيَرُدُّوْنَ سَلَامِيْ عَلَیَّ، وَاَنَّكَ حَجَبْتَ عَنْ سَمْعِيْ كَلَامَهُمْ، وَفَتَحْتَ بَابَ فَهْمِيْ بِلَذِيْذُ مُنَاجَاتِهِمْ۔

trans.en: O Allah! Indeed I have faith in the sanctity of Your Prophet in his absence, just as I have faith in his presence. And I know that verily Your Prophet and Your vicegerents are alive and obtain sustenance near You, they witness my position, and hear my speech, and return my Salaam, and indeed You have concealed their speech from me, and have opened the door of my understanding through the taste of whispering supplications with them.

arabic.text: فَاِنِّیْ اَسْتَاذِنُكَ يَارَبِّ اَوَّلَا، وَاَسْتَاذِنُ رَسُوْلَكَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهٖ ثَانِيًا، وَاَسْتَاذِنُ خَلِيْفَتَكَ الْاِمَامَ الْمَفْرُوْضَ عَلَيَّ طَاعَتُهٗ، فِی الدُّخُوْلِ فِیْ سَاعَتِیْ هٰذِهٖ اِلٰی بَیْتِهٖ، وَاَسْتَاذِنُ مَلَائِكَتَكَ الْمُوَكَّلِیْنَ بِهٰذِهِ الْقِطْعَۃِ الْمُبَارَكَۃِ الْمُطِیْعَۃِ السَّامِعَۃِ۔

trans.en: And indeed I firstly seek permission from You, O Lord; and secondly I seek permission from Your Prophet, peace be upon him and his Progeny, and I seek permission from Your vicegerent, the Imam whose obedience is obligatory on me, to enter his house in this moment, and I seek permission from Your Angels who are appointed by You to serve this holy place, they are obedient and hearing.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمْ اَیُّهَا الْمَلَائِكَۃُ الْمُوَكَّلُوْنَ بِهٰذَا الْمَشْهَدِ الشَّرِیْفِ الْمُبَارَكِ وَرَحْمَۃُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهٗ، بِاِذْنِ اللهِ، وَاِذْنِ رَسُوْلِهٖ، وَاِذْنِ خُلَفَائِهٖ، وَاِذْنِ هٰذَا الْاِمَامِ، وَاِذْنِكُمْ صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ عَلَیْكُمْ اَجْمَعِیْنَ۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you, O Angels who are appointed on this holy and noble shrine; May Allah’s Mercy and Blessings be upon you. With the permission of Allah, and the permission of His Prophet, and the permission of His Vicegerents, and with the permission of this Imam, and with your permission (peace be upon all of you).

arabic.text: اَدْخُلُ اِلٰی هٰذَا الْبَیْتِ مُتَقَرِّبًا اِلَی اللهِ بِاللهِ وَرَسُوْلِهٖ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِهِ الطَّاهِرِیْنَ، فَكُوْنُوْا مَلَائِكَۃَ اللهِ اَعْوَانِیْ، وَكُوْنُوْا اَنْصَارِیْ، حَتّٰی اَدْخُلَ هٰذَا الْبَیْتِ، وَاَدْعُوَ اللهَ بِفُنُوْنِ الدَّعَوَاتِ، وَاَعْتَرَفَ لِلهِ بِالْعُبُوْدِیَّۃِ، وَلِهٰذَا الْاِمَامِ وَاٰبَائِهٖ صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ عَلَیْهِمْ بِالطَّاعَۃِ۔

trans.en: I enter this house seeking the nearness of Allah through Allah and His Prophet, Mohammad and his holy Progeny, thus O Angels of Allah, be my helpers, and be my supporters, so that I enter this house, and I call Allah through various supplications, and I accept my servitude for Allah, and my obedience for this Imam and his ancestors, peace be upon them.

desc.en: Then enter with your right foot and go towards the lower area of the holy vault while saying…
desc.rurdu: Phir pehle daahena qadam (right leg) badhaaye aur daakhil ho aur kahe…
desc.urdu: پھر پیلے داہنا قدم بڑھائیں اور داخل ہوں اور کہیں۔۔۔

arabic.text: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَبِاللهِ، وَفِيْ سَبِيْلِ اللهِ، وَعَلٰى مِلَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهٖ۔ اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِیْكَ لَهٗ، وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهٗ وَرَسُوْلُهٗ۔

trans.en: In the name of Allah and with the help of Allah, and upon the nation of Allah’s Messenger, peace be upon him and his Progeny, I bear witness that there is no God save Allah alone and He has not partner for Himself, and I bear witness that Mohammad is His slave and His Prophet.

desc.en: Thereafter, say Takbeer (Allah o Akbar), Tahmeed (Alhamdolillah), Tasbeeh (Subhanallah) and Tahleel (La ilaha ilallah) until you reach the actual place of the holy vault, then stand facing the Qibla and say…
desc.rurdu: Phir takbeer (Allaho Akbar), tehreer (Alhamdolillah) aur tasbeeh (Subhanallah) o tehleel (La ilaha ilallah) kare aur jab us muqaddas makaan par pohonch jaaye to qibla rukh khade ho kar kahe…
desc.urdu: پھر تکبیر تمجید اور تسبیح و تہلیل کریں اور جب اس مقدس مکان پر متمقر ہو جائیں تو قبلہ رخ کھڑے ہو کر کہیں۔۔۔

arabic.text: سَلَامُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهٗ وَتَحِیَّاتُهٗ وَصَلَوَاتُهٗ عَلٰی مَوْلَایَ صَاحِبِ الزَّمَانِ، صَاحِبِ الضِّیَائِ وَالنُّوْرِ، وَالدِّیْنِ الْمَاثُوْرِ، وَلِلِّوَائِ الْمَشْهُوْرِ، وَالْكِتَابِ الْمَنْشُوْرِ، وَصَاحِبِ الدُّهُوْرِ وَالْعُصُوْرِ، وَخَلَفِ الْحَسَنِ، اَلْاِمَامِ الْمُؤْتَمَنِ، وَالْقَائِمِ الْمُعْتَمَدِ، وَالمَنْصُوْرِ الْمُؤَیَّدِ، وَالْكَهْفِ وَالْعَضُدِ عِمَادِ الْاِسْلَامِ، وَرُكْنِ الْاَنَامِ، وَمِفْتَاحِ الْكَلَامِ، وَ وَلِیِّ الْاَحْكَامِ، وَشَمْسِ الظَّلَامِ، وَبَدْرِ التِّمَامِ، وَنَضْرَۃِ الْاَیَّامِ وَصَاحِبِ الْصَّمْصَامِ، وَفَلَّاقِ الْهَامِ، وَالْبَحْرِ الْقَمْقَامِ، وَالسَّیِّدِ الْهُمَامِ، وَحُجَّۃِ الْخِصَامِ، وَبَابِ الْمَقَامِ لِیَوْمِ الْقِیَامِ۔

trans.en: Allah’s Peace and His Blessings and His Greetings and His Mercy be upon my Master, the Master of Time, the Master of brightness and Light, and the true religion, and the evident flag, and the published book, and the Master of the times and the eras, and the noble successor, and the authentic Imam, and the Reliable Riser, the helped and the supported, the shelter and the promoter, the foundation of Islam, the pillar of the people, the key of speech, the guardian of commands, the illuminator in the darkness, the full moon, the freshness of the days, the owner of sharp sword, the striker of target, the sea brimming with water, the merciful Sayyid, the proof against the enemies, the divine door on the day of Resurrection.

arabic.text: وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَی مُفَرِّجِ الْكُرُبَاتِ، وَخَوَّاضِ الْغَمَرَاتِ، وَمُنَفِّسِ الْحَسَرَاتِ، وَبَقِیَّۃِ اللهِ فِیْ اَرْضِهٖ، وَصَاحِبِ فَرْضِهٖ، وَحُجَّتِهٖ عَلٰی خَلْقِهٖ، وَعَیْبَۃِ عِلْمِهٖ، وَمَوْضِعِ صِدْقِهٖ، وَالْمُنْتَهٰی اِلَیْهِ مَوَارِیْثُ الْاَنْبِیَائِ، وَلَدَیْهِ مَوْجُوْدٌ اٰثَارُ الْاَوْصِیَائِ، وَحُجَّۃِ اللهِ، وَابْنِ رَسُوْلِهٖ، وَالْقَیِّمِ مَقَامَهٗ، وَ وَلِیِّ اَمْرِ اللهِ، وَرَحْمَۃُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهٗ۔

trans.en: And peace be upon them resolver of difficulties, the reliever of hardships, the remover of sorrows, the remainder of Allah on His Earth, the owner of obligatory commands, His argument upon His creation, the bearer of His knowledge, the place of His truth, the inheritor of the fortunes of the Prophets, and the imprints of the successors is available near him, the Argument of Allah, the son of His Prophet, who stands in His place, the Guardian of Allah’s Affairs, peace and blessing be upon him.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ كَمَا انْتَجَبْتَهٗ لِعَلْمِكَ، وَاصْطَفَیْتَهٗ لِحُكْمِكَ، وَخَصَصْتَهٗ بِمَعْرِفَتِكَ، وَجَلَّلْتَهٗ بِكَرَامَتِكَ، وَغَشَّیْتَهٗ بِرَحْمَتِكَ، وَرَبَّیْتَهٗ بِنِعْمَتِكَ، وَغَذَّیْتَهٗ بِحِكْمَتِكَ، وَاخْتَرْتَهٗ لِنَفْسِكَ، وَاجْتَبَیْتَهٗ لِبَاسِكَ، وَارْتَضَیْتَهٗ لِقُدْسِكَ، وَجَعَلْتَهٗ هَادِیًا لِمَنْ شَئْتَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، وَدَیَّانَ الدِّیْنِ بِعَدْلِكَ، وَفَصْلَ الْقَضَایَا بَیْنَ عِبَادِكَ۔

trans.en: O Allah! Just like You have selected him for Your Knowledge, and have chosen him for Your Wisdom, and have specified Your cognizance for him, and have glorified him with Your dignity, and have covered him with Your Mercy, and have nourished him with Your bounties, and have fed him with Your wisdom, and have created him for Yourself, and have chosen him for Your Power, and have preferred him for Your Sanctity, and have made him Your Guide for those whom You wish from You creation, and the ruler of the religion with Your Justice, and the decider of judgments between Your servants.

arabic.text: وَ وَعَدْتَهٗ اَنْ تَجْمَعَ بِهِ الْكَلِمَ، وَتُفَرِّجَ بِهٖ عَنِ الْاُمَمِ، وَتُنِیْرَ بِعَدْلِهِ الظُّلَمَ، وَتُطْفِیَٔ بِهٖ نِیْرَانَ الظُّلْمِ، وَتَقْمَعَ بِهٖ حَرَّالْكُفْرِ وَاٰثَارَهٗ، وَتَطَهِّرَ بِهٖ بِلَادَكَ، وَتَشْفِیَ بِهٖ صُدُوْرَ عِبَادِكَ، وَتَجْمَعَ بِهِ الْمَمَالِكَ كُلَّهَا، قَرِیْبَهَا وَبَعِیْدَهَا، عَذِیْزَهَا وَذَلِیْلَهَا، شَرْقَهَا وَغَرْبَهَا، سَهْلَهَا وَجَبَلَهَا، صَبَاهَا وَدُبُوْرَهَا، شِمَالَهَا وَجُنُوْبَهَا، وَبَرَّهَا وَبَحْرَهَا، حُزُوْنَهَا وَ وُعُوْرَهَا، یَمْلَاُهَا قِسْطًا وَعَدْلًا، كَمَا مُلِئَتْ ظُلْمًا وَجَوْرًا۔

trans.en: And You have promised him to unify all the perspectives through him, and to deliver the nations through him, and to illuminate the darkness through him, and to put of the fire of oppression through him, and to remove the heart of infidelity and its signs through him, and to purify Your cities through him, and to cure the hearts of Your servants through him, and to gather all the realms through him, the near ones and the far away ones, the reputed ones and the disgraced ones, from the east and the west, the plains and the mountains, the graze lands and the deserts, from the north and the south, from the land and the sea, from the plateaus and the terrains, to fill them with justice, just like they were filled with oppression and tyranny.

arabic.text: تُمَكِّنَ لَهٗ فِیْهَا، وَتُنْجِزَ بِهٖ وَعْدَالْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ، حَتّٰی لَا یُشْرَكَ بِكَ شَیْئًا، وَحَتّٰی لَا یَبْقٰی حَقٌّ اِلَّا ظَهَرَ، وَلَا عَدْلٌ اِلَّا زَهَرَ، وَحَتّٰی لَا یَسْتَخْفِیَ بِشَیْءٍ مِنَ الْحَقِّ مَخَافَۃَ اَحَدٍ مِّنَ الْخَلْقِ۔

trans.en: And also promised him to strengthen him in it, and to fulfil the promises made to the believers, until no partner is ascribed with You, and until no truth remains without being prevailed, and no justice remains without being prominent, and until nothing from truth and righteousness is concealed from the people due to the fear of anyone.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَیْهِ صَلَاۃً تَظْهِرُ بِهَا حُجَّتَهٗ، وَتُوْضِحُ بِهَا بَهْجَتَهٗ، وَتَرْفَعُ بِهَا دَرَجَتَهٗ، وَتُؤَیِّدُ بِهَا سُلْطَانَهٗ، وَتُعَظِّمُ بِهَا بُرْهَانَهٗ، وَتُشَرِّفُ بِهَا مَكَانَهٗ، وَتُعْلِیْ بِهَا بُنْیَانَهٗ، تُعِزُّ بِهَا نَصْرَهٗ، وَتَرْفَعُ بِهَا قَدْرَهٗ، بِهَا ذِكْرَهٗ، وَتُظْهِرُ بِهَا كَلِمَتَهٗ، وَتُكَثِّرُ بِهَا نُصْرَتَهٗ، وَتُعِزُّ بِهَا دَعْوَتَهٗ، وَتُزِیْدُهٗ بِهَا اِكْرَامًا، وَتَجْعَلُهٗ لِلْمُتَّقِیْنَ اِمَامًا، وَتُبَلِّغُهُ فِیْ هٰذَا الْمَكَانِ مِثْلَ هٰذَا الْاَوَانِ، وَفِیْ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ مِنَّا تَحِیَّۃً وَسَلَامًا، لَا یَبْلٰی جَدِیْدُهٗ (وَلَا یَفْنٰی عَدِیْدُهٗ)۔

trans.en: O Allah! Bless him with a blessing through which his argument prevails, and his freshness becomes evident, and his position elevates, and his dominion is promoted, and his proof is honoured, and his position is respected, and his foundations are uplifted, and his support is dignified, and his value is raised, and his memory becomes apparent, and his word becomes evident, and his support is exceeded, and his invitation is glorified, and through which You exceed his honour, and You make him the Imam of the pious, and deliver our greetings to him from this place and in this moment and in all place, such that its freshness doesn’t vanish, and its benefits do not end.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا بَقِیَّۃَ اللهِ فِیْ اَرْضِهٖ وَبِلَادِهٖ، وَحُجَّتَهٗ عَلٰی عِبَادِهٖ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا خَلَفَ السَّلَفِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا صَاحِبَ الشَّرَفِ، اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا حُجَّۃَ الْمَعْبُوْدِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا كَلِمَۃَ الْمَحْمُوْدِ۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you, O remainder of Allah on His Earth and His Cities, and His Argument on His creations, peace be upon you O successor of the righteous predecessors, peace be upon you O Owner of Dignity, peace be upon you O Proof of the Lord, peace be upon you O word of the Praised.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا شَمْسَ الشُّمُوْسِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا مَهْدِیَّ الْاَرْضِ وَعَیْنَ الْفَرْضِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا مَوْلَایَ یَا صَاحِبَ الزَّمَانِ وَالْعَالِیَ الشَّانِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا خَاتَمَ الْاَوْصِیَائِ وَابْنَ الْاَنْبِیَائِ۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you O sun of the suns, peace be upon you O Guided among the people of Earth and the Spring of Religion, peace be upon you O my Master, O Master of the Time, O Master of High Value, peace be upon you O seal of successors, and the son of the Prophets.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا مُعِزَّ الْاَوْلِیَائِ وُمُذِلَّ الْاَعْدَائِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا لاْاِمَامُ الْفَرِیْدُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْاِمَامُ الْمُنْتَظَرُ وَالْحَقُّ الْمُشْتَهَرُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْاِمَامُ الْوَلِیُّ الْمُجْتَبٰی وَالْحَقُّ الْمُشْتَهٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْاِمَامُ الْمُرْتَجٰی لِاِزَالَۃِ الْجَوْرِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you O honourer of the Friends and the disgracer of the enemies, peace be upon you O secluded Imam, peace be upon you O Anticipated Imam and the widespread truth, peace be upon you O Imam, the Guardian, the chosen one, the desirable truth. Peace be upon you O Imam who is selected for the removal of oppression and transgression, peace be upon you O Imam, the destroyer of the lecherous and the tyrant.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْاَمَامُ الْمُبِیْدُ لِاَهْلِ الْفُسُوْقِ وَالطُّغْیَانِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْاِمَامَ الْهَادِمُ لِبُنْیَانِ الشِّرْكِ وَالنِّفَاقِ، وَالْحَاصِدْ فُرُوْعَ الْغَیِّ وَالشَّقَاقِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْمُدَّخَرُ لِتَجْدِیْدِ الْفَرَائِضِ وَالسُّنَنِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا طَامِسَ اٰثَارِ الزَّیْغِ وَالْاَهْوَائِ، وَقَاطِعَ حَبَائِلِ الْكِذْبِ وَالْفِتَنِ وَالْاِفْتِرَائِ۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you O Imam, the demolisher of the foundations of polytheism and hypocrisy, who will cut down the branches of misguidance and misfortunes, peace be upon you O he who is treasured for refreshing the obligations and traditions, peace be upon you O destroyer of the signs of deviation and lusts, who will cut the ropes of falsehood, temptations and accusations.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْمُؤَمَّلُ لِاِحْیَائِ الدُّوْلَۃِ الشَّرِیْفَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا جَامِعَ الْكَلِمَۃِ عَلَی التَّقْوٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا بَابَ اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا ثَارَ اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا مُحْیِیْ مَعَالِمِ الدِّیْنِ وَاَهْلِهٖ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا قَاصِمَ شَوْكَۃِ الْمُعْتَدِیْنَ۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you O he who hopes for the revival of the noble nation. Peace be upon you O unifier of the word on piety, peace be upon you O divine doorway, peace be upon you O vengeance of Allah, peace be upon you O Reviver of the signs of religion and the religious men, peace be upon you O destroyer of the glory of the transgressors.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا وَجْهَ اللهِ الَّذِیْ لَا یَهْلَكُ وَلَا یَبْلٰی اِلٰی یَوْمِ الدِّیْنِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا السَّبَبُ الْمُتَّصِلُ بَیْنَ الْاَرْضِ وَالسَّمَائِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا صَاحِبَ الْفَتْحِ وَنَاشِرَ رَاٰیَۃِ الْهُدٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا مُؤَلِّفَ شَمْلِ الصَّلَاحِ وَالرِّضَا۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you O face of Allah, who cannot be destroyed and cannot grow old until the day of Judgment, peace be upon you O cause of connection between the Earth and the Heaven, peace be upon you O Owner of the key and the bearer of the flag of guidance, peace be upon you O gatherer of well-being and satisfaction.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا طَالِبَ ثَارِ الْاَنْبِیَائِ وَاَبْنَائِ الْاَنْبِیَائِ، وَالثَّائِرَ بِدَمِ الْمَقْتُوْلِ بِكَرْبَلَائَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْمَنْصُوْرُ عَلٰی مَنِ اَعْتَدٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْمُنْتَظَرُ الْمُجَابُ اِذَا دَعٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا بَقِیَّۃَ الْخَلَائِفِ، اَلْبَرُّ التَّقِیُّ، اَلْبَاقِیْ لِاِزَالَۃِ الْجَوْرِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you O seeker of the vengeance of the Prophets and the son of the Prophets, and the avenger of the blood of Karbala s martyr, peace be upon you O supported one against the tyrant, peace be upon you O Anticipated one whose supplication is accepted, peace be upon you O remainder of the successors, the noble and the pious, the remainder for the removal of oppressions and transgression.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ مُحَمَّدِ
الْمُصْطَفٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ عَلِیِّ
الْمُرْتَضٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ فَاطِمَۃَ الزَّهْرَائِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ خَدِیْجَۃَ الْكُبْرٰی، وَابْنَ السَّادَۃِ الْمُقَرَّبِیْنَ وَالْقَادَۃِ الْمُتَّقِیْنَ۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you O son of Mohammad, the chosen one, peace be upon you O son of Ali, the content one, peace be upon you O son of Lady Fatima Zahra, peace be upon you O son of Lady Khadijatul Kubra, and the son of the chiefs who are close to Allah’s threshold and the pious leaders.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ النُّجَبَائِ الْاَكْرَمِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْاَصْفِیَائِ الْمُهَذَّبِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْهُدَاۃِ الْمَهْدِیِّیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ خِیَرَۃِ الْخِیَرِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ سَادَۃِ الْبَشَرِ۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you O son of the honourable noblemen, peace be upon you O son of the pure chosen ones, peace be upon you O son of the guided guides, peace be upon you O son of the best of all the bests, peace be upon you O son of the leaders of the humans.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْغَطَارِفَۃِ الْاَكْرَمِیْنَ، وَالْاَطَائِبِ الْمَطَهَّرِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْبَرَرَۃِ الْمُنْتَجَبِیْنَ، وَالْخَضَارِمَۃِ الْاَنْجَبِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْحُجَجِ الْمُنِیْرَۃِ، وَالسُّرُجِ الْمُضِیْئَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الشُّهُبِ الثَاقِبَۃَ۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you O son of the honourable masters, and the purified men, peace be upon you O son of the chosen noblemen, and the honourable bestowers, peace be upon you O son of the luminescent Proofs, and the glowing lamps, peace be upon you O son of the shining stars.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ قَوَاعِدِ الْعِلْمِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ مَعَادِنِ الْحِلْمِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْكَوَاكِبِ الزَّاهِرَۃِ، وَالنُّجُوْمِ الْبَاهِرَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الشُّمُوْسِ الطَّالِعَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْاَقْمَارِ السَّاطِعَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ السُّبُلِ الْوَاضِحَۃِ، وَالْاَعْلَامِ اللّٰائِحَۃِ۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you O son of the pillars of knowledge, peace be upon you O son of the mines of endurance, peace be upon you O son of the bright planets, and the beautiful stars, peace be upon you O son of the risen suns, peace be upon you O sons of the glowing moons, peace be upon you O sons of the evident paths, and the apparent signs.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ السُّنَنِ الْمَشْهُوْرَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْمَعَالِمِ الْمَاثُوْرَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الشَّوَاهِدِ الْمَشْهُوْدَۃِ، وَالْمُعْجِزَاتِ الْمَوْجُوْدَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الصِّرَاطِ الْمُسْتَقِیْمِ، وَالنَّبَاِ الْعَظِیْمِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْآیَاتِ الْبَیِّنَاتِ، وَالدَّلَائِلِ الظَّاهِرَاتِ۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you O son of the famous traditions, peace be upon you O son of the remnant signs, peace be upon you O son of the witnessed witnesses, and the present miracles, peace be upon you O son of the straight path, and the great news, peace be upon you O son of the clear signs, and the evident proofs.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْبَرَاهِیْنِ الْوَاضِحَاتِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْحُجَجِ الْبَالِغَاتِ، وَالنِّعَمِ السَّابِغَاتِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ طٰهٰ وَالْمُحْكَمَاتِ، وَیٰسٓ وَالذَّارِیَاتِ، وَالطُّوْرِ وَالْعَادِیَاتِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ مَنْ دَنٰی فَتَدَلّٰی فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَیْنِ اَوْ اَدْنٰی، وَاقْتَرَبَ مِنَ الْعَلِیِّ الْاَعْلٰی۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you O son of the obvious arguments, peace be upon you O son of effective evidences, and the abundant bounties, peace be upon you O son of Taha and the precise verse, and Yaseen and Zaariyaat, and Toor and wal-Aadiyaat, peace be upon you O son of him who drew near and came down till he was at two bow s length or nearer, and neared the Sublime, the Supreme.

arabic.text: لَیْتَ شِعْرِیْ اَیْنَ اسْتَقَرَّتْ بِكَ النَّوٰی، اَوْ اَنْتَ بِوَادِیْ طُوٰی، وَزِیْزٌ عَلَیَّ اَنْ اَرَی الْخَلْقَ وَلَا تُرٰی، وَلَایُسْمَعُ لَكَ حَسِیْسٌ وَلَا نَجْوٰی، عَزِیْزٌ عَلَیَّ اَنْ یُرَی الْخَلْقُ وَلَا تُرٰی، عَزِیْزٌ اَنْ تُحِیْطَ بِكَ الْاَعْدَائُ۔

trans.en: If I but knew the destination of your perfect journey, are you in a well-guarded concealed valley, it breaks my heart when I look at all that is created but cannot see you, nor hear a whisper about your whereabouts nor any secret communication, it breaks my heart that the creations can be seen but you cannot be seen, it is disheartening for me to know that you are surrounded by the enemies.

arabic.text: بِنَفْسِیْ اَنْتَ مِنْ مُغَیَّبٍ مَا غَابَ عَنَّا، بِنَفْسِیْ اَنْتَ مِنْ نَازِحٍ مَانَزَحَ عَنَّا وَنَحْنُ نَقُوْلُ۔ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِیْنَ، وَصَلَّی اللهُ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِهٖ اَجْمَعِیْنَ۔

trans.en: I eagerly long for the hidden who is not actually hidden from us, I eagerly long for you who has departed but is not far from us, and we say, praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds, and peace be upon Mohammad and his entire Progeny.

desc.en: Now raise your hands and recite…
desc.rurdu: Iske baad phir apne haatho’n ko baland kare aur kahe…
desc.urdu: اس کے بعد پھر اپنے ہاتھوں کو بلند کریں اور کہیں۔۔۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ كَاشِفُ الْكُرَبِ اَالْبَلْوٰی، وَاِلَیْكَ نَشْكُوْ غَیْبَۃَ اِمَامِنَا، وَابْنِ بِنْتِ نَبِیِّنَا۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ فَامْلَا بِهِ الْاَرْضَ عَدْلَا وَقِسْطًا، كَمَا مُلِئَتْ ظُلْمًا وَّجَوْرَا۔

trans.en: O Allah! Indeed You are the disperser of sorrows and hardships, and to You we complain regarding the occultation of our Imams, and the son of Prophet’s daughter. O Allah! Fill the earth with justice like it was filled with oppression and tyranny.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاَهْلِ بَیْتِهٖ، وَاَرِنَا سَیِّدَنَا وَصَاحِبَنَا وَاِمَامَنَا وَمَوْلَانَا صَاحِبَ الزَّمَانِ، وَمَلْجَأَ اَهْلِ عَصْرِنَا، وَمَنْجَا اَهْلِ دَهْرِنَا، ظَاهِرَالْمَقَالَۃِ، وَاضِحَ الدَّلَالَۃِ، هَادِیًا مِنَ الضَّلَالَۃِ، مُنْقِذًا مِنَ الْجَهَالَۃِ، وَاَظْهِرْ مَعَالِمَهٗ، وَثَبِّتْ قَوَاعِدَهٗ وَاَعِزَّ نَصْرَهٗ، وَاَطِلْ عُمْرَهٗ، وَاَبْسِطْ جَاهَدُ، وَاَحْیِ اَمْرَهٗ، وَاَظْهِرْ نُوْرَهٗ، وَقَرِّبْ بُعْدَهٗ، وَاَنْجِزْ وَعْدَهٗ، وَاَوْفِ عَهْدَهٗ۔

trans.en: O Allah! Bless Mohammad and his household, and show us our Leader, our Owner, our Imam, and our Master, the Master of Time, the Shelter of our age, the deliverer of our time, with evident speech and clear proofs, a guide from the misguidance, a rescuer from ignorance, and make his signs apparent, and strengthen his pillars, and dignify his support, and elongate his life, and extend his position, and revive his affair, and display his light, and bring his distance near, and fulfil his promises, and accomplish his oaths.

arabic.text: وَزَیِّنِ الْاَرْضَ بِطُوْلِ بَقَائِهٖ، وَدَوَامِ مُلْكِهٖ، وَعُلُوِّ ارْتِقَائِهٖ، وَارْتِفَاعِهٖ، وَاَنِرْ مَشَاهِدَهٗ، وَثَبِّتْ قَوَاعِدَهٗ، وَعَظِّمْ بُرْهَانَهٗ، وَاَمِدْ سُلْطَانَهٗ، وَاَعْلِ مَكَانَهٗ، وَقَوِّ اَرْكَانَهٗ، وَاَرِنَا وَجْهَهٗ، وَاَوْضِحْ بَهْجَتَهٗ، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهٗ، وَاَظْهِرْ كَلِمَتَهٗ، وَاَعِزَّ دَعْوَتَهٗ، وَاَعْطِهِ سُؤْلَهٗ، بَلِّغْهُ یَا رَبِّ مَامُوْلَهٗ، وَشَرِّفْ مَقَامَهٗ، وَعَظِّمْ اِكْرَامَهٗ۔

trans.en: And beautify the Earth with his extensive existence, and his eternal kingdom, and his high elevation and rise, and brighten the places of his existence, and strengthen his pillars, and dignify his arguments, and extend his dominion, and elevate his position, and strengthen his pillars, and show us his face, and display his happiness, and rise his status, and succeed his word, and glorify his invitation, and fulfil his desires, and deliver to him all that he hopes for, O Lord, and honour his position, greaten his respect.

arabic.text: وَاَعِزَّبِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ، وَاَحْیِ بِهٖ سُنَنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ، وَاَذِلَّ بِهِ الْمُنَافِقِیْنَ، وَاَهْلِكْ بِهِ الْجَبَّارِیْنَ، وَاكْفِهٖ بَغْیَ الْحَاسِدِیْنَ، وَاَعِذْهُ مِنْ شَرِّ الْكَائِدِیْنَ، وَازْجُرْ عَنْهُ اِرَادَۃَ الظَّالِمِیْنَ، وَاَیِّدْهُ بِجُنُوْدٍ مِّنَ الْمَلَائِكَۃِ مُسَوِّمِیْنَ، وَسَلِّطْهُ عَلٰی اَعْدَائِ دِیْنِكَ اَجْمَعِیْنَ۔

trans.en: And dignify the believers through him, and revive the traditions of the Prophets through him, and humiliate the hypocrites through him, and destroy the tyrants, and suffice him against the oppression of the jealous men, and provide him shelter from the evil of the schemers, and keep the wicked intentions of the transgressors from him, and support him with an army of the known angels.

arabic.text: وَاَقْصِمْ بِهٖ كُلَّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِیْدٍ، وَاَخْمِدْ بِسَیْفِهٖ كُلَّ نَارٍ وَقَیْدٍ، وَاَنْفِذْ حُكْمَهٗ فِیْ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ، وَاَقِمْ بِسُلْطَانِهٖ كُلَّ سُلْطَانٍ، وَاَقْمِعْ بِهٖ عَبَدَۃَ الْاَوْثَانِ، وَشَرَّفْ بِهٖ اَهْلَ الْقُرْآنِ وَالْاِیْمَانِ، وَاَظْهِرْهُ عَلٰی كُلِّ الْاَدْیَانِ، وَاَكْبِتْ مَنْ عَادَاهُ، وَاَذِلَّ مَنْ نَاوَاهُ، وَاسْتَاصِلْ مَنْ جَحَدَ حَقَّهٗ، وَاَنْكَرَ صِدْقَهٗ، وَاسْتَهَانَ بِاَمْرِهٖ، وَاَرَادَ اِخْمَادَ ذِكْرَهِ، وَسَعٰی فِیْ اِطْفَائِ نُوْرِهٖ۔

trans.en: And dominate him over all the enemies of Your religion, destroy all the adamant tyrants through him, and extinguish all the blazing fire through his sword, and establish his order everywhere, and create all the kingdom under his dominion, destroy the idol worshippers through him, and honour the people of Qur’an and the faithful, and succeed him over all the religions, and make his enemies helpless, and humiliate whoever targets him, and overpower all those who deny his right, reject his truth, weaken his affair, wishes to destroy his memory, and strives to put off his light.

arabic.text: اَللّٰھُمَّ نُوِّرْ بِنُوْرِهٖ كُلِّ ظُلْمَۃٍ، وَاكْشِفْ بِهٖ كُلَّ غُمَّۃٍ، وَقَدِّمْ اَمَامَهَ الرُّعْبَ، وَثَبِّتْ بِهِ الْقَلْبَ، وَاَقِمْ بِهٖ نُصْرَۃَ الْحَرْبِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ الْقَائِمَ الْمُؤَمَّلَ، وَالْوَاصِیَّ الْمُفَضَّلَ، وَالْاِمَامَ الْمُنْتَظَرَ، وَالْعَدْلَ الْمُخْتَبَرَ، وَامْلَا بِهِ الْاَرْضَ عَدْلًا وَقِسْطًا، كَمَا مُلِئَتْ جَوْرًا وَظُلْمًا، وَاَعِنْهُ عَلٰی مَا وَلَّیْتَهٗ وَاسْتَخَلَفْتَهٗ وَاسْتَرْ عَیْتَهٗ، حَتّٰی یَجْرِیَ حُكْمُهٗ عَلٰی كُلِّ حُكْمٍ، وَیَهْدِیَ بِحَقِّهٖ كُلَّ ضَلَالَۃٍ وَاحْرُسْهُ۔

trans.en: O Allah! Brighten all the darkness through his light, and disperse all the sorrows through him, and send his terror ahead of him, and strengthen the heart through him, and establish the victory of battle through him, and make him the desired Riser, and the best successor, and the anticipated Imam, and the examined just person, and fill the Earth with justice through him like it was filled with oppression and tyranny, and support him in the things concerning his guardianship, caliphate and observance, so that his order rules over all the orders, and guides with his right all the misguidance.

arabic.text: اَللّٰھُمَّ بِعَیْنِكَ الَّتِیْ لَا تَنَامُ، وَاكْنُفْهُ بِرُكْنِكَ الَّذِیْ لَا یُرَامُ، وَاَعِزَّهُ بِعِزِّكَ الَّذِیْ لَا یُضَامُ، وَاجْعَلْنِیْ یَا اِلٰهِیْ مِنْ عَدَدِهٖ وَمَدَدِهٖ، وَاَنْصَارِهٖ وَاَعْوَانِهٖ وَاَرْكَانِهٖ وَاَشْیَاعِهٖ وَاَتْبَاعِهٖ، وَاَذِقْنِیْ طَعْمَ فَرْحَتِهٖ، وَاَلْبِسْنِیْ ثَوْبَ بَهْجَتِهٖ، وَاَحْصِرْنِیْ مَعَهُ لِبَیْعَتِهٖ، وَتَاكِیْدِ عَقْدِهٖ بَیْنَ الرُّكْنِ وَالْمَقَامِ عِنْدَ بَیْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ۔

trans.en: O Allah! Safeguard him with Your Eye that doesn’t sleep, and supervise him under your firm supervision, and dignify him with Your unending honour, and regard me, O Lord, amongst his soldiers and his supporters, his helpers and his pillars, his followers and his devotees, and give me the taste of his happiness, and cover me with the attire of his freshness, and avail me alongside him for pledging allegiance with him, so that I can emphasise on the allegiance I have pledged with him between the Rukn and the Maqaam near Your holy House.

arabic.text: وَ وَفِّقْنِیْ یَا رَبِّ لِلْقِیَامِ بِطَاعَتِهٖ، وَالْمَثْوٰی فِیْ خِدْمَتِهٖ، وَالْمَكْثِ دَوْلَتِهٖ، وَاجْتِنَابِ مَعْصِیَتِهٖ، فَاِنْ تَوَفَّیْتَنِیْ اَللّٰھُمَّ قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ، فَاجْعَلْنِیْ یَا رَبِّ فِیْ مَنْ یَكِرُّ فِیْ رَجْعَتِهٖ، وَیَمْلِكُ فِیْ دَوْلَتِهٖ، وَیَتَمَكَّنُ فِیْ اَیَّامِهٖ، وَیَسْتَظِلُّ تَحْتَ اَعْلَامِهٖ، وَیُحْشَرُ فِیْ زُمْرَتِهٖ، وَتَقَرُّ عَیْنُۃٗ بِرُؤْیَتِهٖ، بِفَضْلِكَ وَاِحْسَانِكَ، وَكَرَمِكَ وَامْتِنَانِكَ، اِنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِیْمِ، وَالْمَنِّ الْقَدِیْمِ، وَالْاِحْسَانِ الْكَرِیْمِ۔

trans.en: O Lord, succeed me for the establishment of Your obedience, and for seeking shelter in his service, and for staying in his kingdom, and for distancing from sins, thus if You put me to death before the establishment of his kingdom, then regard me, O Lord, amongst those who will return at the time of return, who will become the rulers, and will become powerful in his days, and will gather under his flag, and will be raised alongside him, and they eyes will be calmed by his sight, with Your Grace and Your Favour, Your Kindness and Your Generosity, indeed You are the Gracious, the Great, the Eternal benevolent, the Mighty, the Beneficent.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔

desc.en: Then offer 12 units of prayer (six prayers of 2 units each) wherever you may be and in each unit after <Surah Fateha> recite whichever Surah you wish and send its reward to his holiness (a). After offering the Salaam of each 2 unit prayer, recite the Tasbeeh of Lady Fatima Zahra (s), then say…
desc.rurdu: Phir 12 rakat namaz 2x2 kar ke namaz-e-Subh ki tarah padhe aur Hazrat Baqiyyatullah Al-Aazam ki khidmat mein hadiya kare aur jab yeh 2 rakat namaz padh rahe ho to har 2 rakat namaz ke baad Tasbeeh-e-Zahra (s) padhe aur yeh dua bhi padhe…
desc.urdu: پھر ۱۲ رکعت نماز دو دو کر کے نماز صبح کی طرح پڑھے اور حضرت بقیۃ اللہ ارواحنا فداہ کی خدمت میں ہدیہ کریں اور جب یہ ۲ رکعت نماز پڑھ رہے ہوں تو ہر ۲ رکعت کے بعد تسبیح زہراؑ پڑھیں اور یہ دُعا بھی پڑھیں۔۔۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰھُمَّ اَنْتَ اَلسَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، وَاِلَیْكَ یَعُوْدُ السَّلَامُ، حَیِّنَا رَبَّنَا مِنْكَ بِالسَّلَامِ۔ اَللّٰھُمَّ اِنَّ هٰذِهِ الرَّكَعَاتِ هَدِیَّۃٌ مِنِّیْ اِلٰی وَلِیِّكَ وَابْنِ وَلِیِّكَ وَابْنِ اَوْلِیَائِكَ، اَلْاِمَامِ بْنِ الْاَئِمَّۃِ، اَلْخَلَفِ الْصَالِحِ، اَلْحُجَّۃِ صَاحِبِ الزَّمَانِ، فَصَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدً وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَبَلِّغْهُ اِیَّاهَا، وَاَعْطِنِیْ اَفْضَلَ اَمَلِیْ وَرَجَائِیْ فِیْكَ وَفِیْ رَسُوْلِكَ، صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَیْهِ وَعَلٰی اٰلِهٖ اَجْمَعِیْنَ وَفِیْهِ۔

trans.en: O Allah! You are Peace and from You is Peace, and towards You returns Peace, and gift us, O Lord, with Peace from You. O Allah! These units are a gift from me to Your Guardian, and the son of Your Guardian and the son of Your Friends, the Imam son of the Imams, the rightful successor, the Proof, the Master of Time; bless Mohammad and his holy Progeny, and deliver these prayers to him, and grant me with the best of my desire and hope in You and in Your Prophet and in him, Your Peace and blessing be upon him and his entire Progeny.

desc.en: Sayyid bin Taoos says: after offering the prayer, recite the famous supplication which is recite in the period of occultation of his holiness (a).
desc.rurdu: Sayed Ali bin Tawoos farmate hai keh namaz ke baad maaroof dua jo ghaibat Imam-e-Asr (a) ke dauraan padhi jaati hai usko padhe.
desc.urdu: سید علی بن طاؤوس فرماتے ہیں: نماز کے بعد معروف دُعا جو غیبتِ امامِ عصرؑ کے دوران پڑھی جاتی ہے اس کو پڑھیں۔
